articles.author: Steve Hendrix
articles.title: U.K. Parliament rejects bill to allow assisted dying for the terminally ill - The Washington Post
articles.description: The defeat leaves Britain outside a growing list of European countries and 14 U.S. jurisdictions that allow some form of assisted suicide.
articles.content: LONDON A push in Britain to legalize assisted dying collapsed Friday with an emotional House of Commons vote to reject a bill that would have allowed the terminally ill to seek help ending their live… [+1 chars]
